Separate paging is given to this part in order that it may be filed as a Separate Compilation. 
 
PART   I-A 
CENTRAL SECTION 
Orders  and  Notifications  (Other than those published in Part IV-B) 
under the Gujarat Local Boards, Village Panchayats, Municipal 
Boroughs, District Municipal, Primary Education and Local Fund Audit Acts. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
PANCHAYATS, RURAL HOUSING AND RURAL DEVELOPMENT DEPARTMENT 
NOTIFICATION 
Sachivalaya, Gandhinagar, 1st July, 2024 
GUJARAT PANCHAYATS ACT, 1993. 
No. KP/17 of 2024/PRHRDD/GRT/e-file/14/2023/5975/Section-G:- The following draft of rules which is proposed to 
be issued under section 274 read with sub-section (3) of section 51 of the Gujarat Panchayats Act, 1993 (Guj.18 of 
1993) (hereinafter referred to as “The said Act”) is published as required by sub-section (5) of section 274 of the said 
Act, for the information of all persons likely to be affected thereby and notice is hereby given that the said draft will be 
taken into consideration by the Government of Gujarat on or after the expiry of the period of thirty days from the date 
of publication of this notification in the Official Gazette.  
2. 
Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the Principal Secretary to the Government of Gujarat, 
Panchayats, Rural Housing and Rural Development Department, Sachivalaya, Gandhinagar, from any person 
with respect to the said draft rules on or before the expiry of the aforesaid period will be considered by the 
Government. 
I-A Ex.-17 
17-1

GUJARAT GOVERNMENT GAZETTE, EX., 01-07-2024 
 [ PART  I-A 
DRAFT NOTIFICATION 
No. KP/17 of 2024/PRHRDD/GRT/e-file/14/2023/5975/Section-G:- In exercise of the powers conferred by section 
274 read with sub-section (3) of section 51 of the Gujarat Panchayats Act, 1993 (Guj.18 of 1993), the Government of 
Gujarat hereby makes the following rules further to amend the Gujarat Village Panchayats Election of Sarpanch 
(Manner of Allotment of Reserved Offices of Sarpanch by Rotation) Rules, 1994, namely:- 
1. 
 (1) 
These rules may be called the Gujarat Village Panchayats Election of Sarpanch (Manner of Allotment of 
Reserved Offices of Sarpanch by Rotation) (Amendment) Rules, 2024. 
(2) 
They shall come into force from the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. 
2. 
In the Gujarat Village Panchayats Election of Sarpanch (Manner of Allotment of Reserved Offices of Sarpanch 
by Rotation) Rules, 1994, in rule 4, in sub-rule (3), for the words "ten percent of the total number of offices  
of sarpanch of village panchayats in a taluka.", the words, brackets and figures- "twenty-seven per cent. of the 
total number of offices of sarpanch of village panchayats in a taluka subject to the provisos to clause (a) of  
sub-section (2) of section 51 of the Act." shall be substituted. 
By order and in the name of the Governor of Gujarat, 
SIMRAN POPTANI, 
Deputy Secretary to Government. 
 
---------- 
 
Signed by:BHOLUSINGH G THAKUR
Date: 2024.07.02 18:30:07 +05:30
Reason: Validate Document

Gandhinagar
Signature Not Verified
